name: io.github.calligraphysystems/vibe-hardware-mcp
title: Vibe-Coding Hardware & Autonomous PCB Physical Synthesis MCP Server
description: Zero-dependency Python 3 MCP server & Streamable HTTP endpoint for KiCad (.kicad_pcb), Specctra (.dsn), Altium (.PcbDoc), atopile (.ato), and tscircuit (.tsx) PCB layout analysis, IPC-2141A microstrip/stripline impedance & IPC-2152 current calculation, DFM rule auditing (JLCPCB/PCBWay), and autonomous multi-layer 3D PCB routing (0 native KiCad 9 DRC violations across 55/55 verified open-source benchmark boards).

tools.name: analyze_kicad_pcb
tools.description: Parse a KiCad .kicad_pcb S-expression locally to extract copper layers, board outline dimensions (mm), component/pad counts, fine-pitch density, netlist summary, and routed track/via statistics.

tools.name: analyze_specctra_dsn
tools.description: Parse a Specctra .dsn autorouter file locally to extract units, resolution, signal/power layers, boundary dimensions, component pin count, net connectivity, and design rule clearances/widths.

tools.name: calculate_pcb_trace_impedance
tools.description: Closed-form IPC-2141A microstrip & stripline characteristic impedance (Z0), edge-coupled differential pair impedance (Zdiff), propagation delay (ps/mm), and IPC-2152 DC current capacity / temperature-rise calculator.

tools.name: audit_pcb_dfm_rules
tools.description: Audit .kicad_pcb and .dsn trace widths, clearances, via drill diameters, and annular rings against standard_2l, standard_4l, and fine_hdi fabrication rules (JLCPCB / PCBWay).

tools.name: calligraphy_list_gallery_boards
tools.description: List the verified open-source reference PCB catalog and 55/55 benchmark suite (100.0% routed completion, 0 native KiCad 9 copper DRC violations).

tools.name: calligraphy_preflight_audit
tools.description: Run a free ($0) pre-flight CAD doctor, layer/pad/fine-pitch audit, and instant tier quote on a .kicad_pcb, .dsn, .PcbDoc, .ato, .tsx, or .zip board payload.

tools.name: calligraphy_compile_board
tools.description: Submit a PCB layout or hardware archive for autonomous multi-layer 3D routing, curvilinear G1 arc & teardrop reinforcement, and 350-DPI visual proof verification.

tools.name: calligraphy_get_job_status
tools.description: Poll live synthesis progress, routing completion percentage, native KiCad DRC verification count, and 350-DPI proof tile readiness for a job.

tools.name: calligraphy_verify_stablecoin_payment
tools.description: Verify on-chain USDC/USDT settlement (Base L2 / Ethereum) to unlock a completed turnkey manufacturing bundle.

tools.name: calligraphy_download_fab_bundle
tools.description: Download the unlocked turnkey fabrication .zip bundle (routed .kicad_pcb, RS-274X Gerbers, Excellon drills, IPC-D-356 netlist, JLCPCB BOM/CPL, and 3D WebGL viewer).

tools.name: calligraphy_lookup_b2b_invoice
tools.description: Retrieve the printable B2B tax invoice and cryptographic chain-of-custody verification certificate for a job.

tools.name: calligraphy_create_coinbase_checkout
tools.description: Generate a Coinbase Onramp / Base L2 USDC checkout session for a completed synthesis job.

tools.name: calligraphy_purge_job_vault
tools.description: Cryptographically shred and purge all uploaded CAD artifacts and output bundles for a job from the cloud enclave.

tools.name: calligraphy_route_pcb
tools.description: Alias for calligraphy_compile_board to trigger autonomous multi-layer 3D PCB routing.

tools.name: calligraphy_request_ip_whitelist
tools.description: Submit an enterprise IP whitelist request for high-volume autonomous CI/CD hardware synthesis pipelines.
